title: sideritis glacialis subsp. pulvinata
intro: Sideritis glacialis subsp. pulvinata, commonly known as White Mountain Ironwort, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, known for its medicinal properties and traditional use in folk medicine. It is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, digestive problems, and respiratory tract infections, thanks to its health benefits of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of White Mountain Ironwort are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and improve immune function, making it a valuable natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are found in its leaves, flowers, and stems.
